text:
Nothing documented happened to Paul McCartney on November 9, 1966; the sources place him on holiday with Jane Asher in France and Kenya from 6 to 19 November ([Beatles Bible](https://beatlesbible.com/features/paul-is-dead)). That date belongs to the "Paul is dead" hoax, which claimed he died in a car crash that day and was secretly replaced, and [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Paul_is_dead) documents it as a false rumour. The sources conflict on a minor accident around then: one says a motorcycle crash on that date, while another dates a moped crash to December 1965, so I'd treat any real incident that day as unverified.

CONFIDENCE: 80
